function.name: gifts
function.description: Find gifts at real online stores, live. Each item is "store word", e.g. "brooklinen robe". Returns the top in-stock product per item, one line each: "- title price URL". Stores: stanley (tumblers, drinkware); brooklinen (robes, bedding, towels); allbirds (wool shoes, slippers); deathwish (coffee, mugs); leatherman (multitools, knives); ugmonk (desk organizers); puravida (bracelets, jewelry); colourpop (makeup); taylorstitch (menswear); kylie (cosmetics).

messages.content:
Be terse. Do not deliberate.
